forecasts.question: Will Iran's IRGC conduct a ballistic missile or drone strike on US military assets in the Gulf region by September 5, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: First day — F9 created in response to Sep 1 CENTCOM strikes on IRGC positions inside Iran (Qeshm, Jask) and confirmed IRGC ballistic missile salvo toward Jordan and UAE that same day. Historical pattern: IRGC has retaliated within 72h of direct CENTCOM kinetic action on Iranian soil in all documented prior cases (Apr 2026, Jun 2026). IRGC Aerospace Force on elevated readiness per OSINT imagery. 60% reflects high base rate against the chance the Sep 1 retaliation was itself the primary cycle-closing strike.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if any IRGC or IRGC-proxy ballistic missile, cruise missile, or drone swarm is confirmed by CENTCOM, UK NAVCENT, or ≥2 TIER1 wire services to have struck or been intercepted en route to a US base, ship, or aircraft in the Gulf region (Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, UAE, Gulf waters) by 23:59 UTC Sep 5, 2026. YES requires TIER1 confirmation, not only IRGC claim.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM press release OR US DoD statement OR TIER1 confirmation (Reuters/AP/AFP with named official or verifiable damage report). IRGC state-media claim alone = AMBIGUOUS.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Strike that hits non-US partner assets but not US forces/equipment = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A strike launched but fully intercepted before impact = YES (launch is the event, not damage). Strike after Sep 5 23:59 UTC = NO.

indicators.name: IRGC Aerospace Force operational-readiness posture (OSINT imagery / NOTAM watch)
indicators.expected_effect: OBSERVED = +15pp toward YES; CONTRADICTED (stand-down) = -25pp

indicators.name: US carrier-strike-group repositioning out of Gulf (tactical withdrawal)
indicators.expected_effect: OBSERVED = -10pp (US pulling assets signals de-escalation window)

indicators.name: IRGC leadership public statement demanding retaliation or denying intent
indicators.expected_effect: Explicit public demand = +5pp; explicit stand-down = -20pp

forecasts.question: Will the US and Iran reach and publicly confirm a formal or interim agreement restoring Hormuz shipping to pre-closure baseline (≥80% of pre-war transit volume) by September 14, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: Sep 1 CENTCOM strikes inside Iran and same-day IRGC retaliation to Jordan/UAE collapsed any residual diplomatic track for this window. F1 (MFA conditions statement) resolved NO today, removing the gating prerequisite. F8 (strike pause) also resolved NO. With direct military exchange ongoing, a formal deal by Sep 14 is structurally foreclosed; 5% is the schema floor reflecting non-zero chance of emergency backchannel capitulation under sustained economic pressure.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if a US and Iranian official (cabinet level or above) publicly confirms a signed or initialled agreement in writing that includes a timetable for restoring Hormuz transit to ≥80% of pre-war baseline, confirmed by ≥2 TIER1 sources, before Sep 14 23:59 UTC 2026.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP with named official confirmation OR US State Dept/Iranian MFA joint statement. Unilateral Iranian claim without US confirmation = AMBIGUOUS.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A verbal announcement without a signed text, or a ceasefire-only deal that does not address Hormuz transit = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Partial reopening without formal agreement = NO.

indicators.name: US-Iran backchannel contact confirmed by ≥1 TIER1 source
indicators.expected_effect: OBSERVED = +15pp; CONTRADICTED (active strikes) = -10pp and sustained there

indicators.name: Hormuz transit rate climbing above 50% of pre-war baseline (Lloyd's AIS)
indicators.expected_effect: +10pp if rate trend reverses toward 50%+

forecasts.question: Will Oman host or publicly facilitate a formal US-Iran back-channel session by September 14, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: First day — F10 created as Oman-specific mediation track distinct from F2 (formal deal). Oman hosted seven prior rounds of US-Iran back-channel talks (2019-2025) and maintained open lines with both parties through the current conflict. Sep 1 escalation raises Omani incentive to mediate; however, direct CENTCOM strikes inside Iran historically trigger an Iranian 'no-talks-under-fire' posture for 10-30 days. 15% reflects Oman's established channel against the expected Iranian refusal window. Criterion: publicly confirmed held session, not merely Oman 'willingness' statement.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if Oman's MFA or ≥2 TIER1 sources confirm that a US and Iranian representative held a face-to-face or structured back-channel session in Oman or via Omani facilitation, with at least one substantive agenda item documented, by Sep 14 23:59 UTC 2026.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Oman MOFA statement OR Reuters/AP/AFP with named Omani or US/Iranian official. Anonymous 'sources say Oman is facilitating' without session confirmation = AMBIGUOUS.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Oman conveying a written message between parties without a direct meeting = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A session held but not publicly confirmed by Sep 14 = NO (this forecast requires public confirmation within window).

indicators.name: Oman FM or Sultan bilateral contact with both Washington and Tehran within 72h
indicators.expected_effect: +10pp if both contacts confirmed within 72h

indicators.name: Iranian MFA statement accepting Omani facilitation or lifting 'no-talks-under-fire' posture
indicators.expected_effect: +20pp if observed; explicit rejection = -10pp

forecasts.question: Will Iran grant the IAEA full inspector access to all previously restricted sites (including Fordow and Natanz advanced centrifuge halls) by September 30, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: Iran Atomic Energy Organization Chief (Aug 26) issued formal blocking doctrine: IAEA cannot inspect war-damaged sites until new inspection protocols agreed — a structural prerequisite that cannot be met before Sep 30. IAEA DG confirmed Sep 1-2 that Iran's access is 'unclear' and issued 'urgent need' statement. These confirm both an institutional barrier (new protocol requirement) and a current-state barrier (active denial). Analyst diverged from DA (0.22 vs ~0.10); Judge resolves at 0.11: DA's additional evidence of the Aug 26 doctrine is event-anchored and materially changes the assessment. Prior 0.22 assumed negotiated access was still possible within window; blocking doctrine removes that pathway.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if IAEA DG publicly confirms unrestricted inspector access to Fordow and Natanz advanced centrifuge halls, documented in an IAEA Board report or official DG statement, by Sep 30 23:59 UTC 2026. 'Access to some but not all previously restricted sites' = NO.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IAEA Board of Governors official report OR IAEA DG public statement OR Reuters/AP/AFP citing IAEA official with access confirmation. Iranian MFA claim without IAEA confirmation = AMBIGUOUS.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Partial access (some sites but not all previously restricted) = NO. Access granted but inspectors not yet on-site by Sep 30 = NO. IAEA 'progress' statement without confirmed access = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: IAEA DG 'urgent need' statement or Board extraordinary session called
indicators.expected_effect: OBSERVED = -5pp (escalation of diplomatic pressure, not access); confirms blocked state

indicators.name: Iran AEOI blocking doctrine lifted or new inspection protocol agreed
indicators.expected_effect: OBSERVED (doctrine lifted) = +20pp; current CONTRADICTED state = primary downward driver

indicators.name: US-Iran ceasefire or deal that includes nuclear access clause
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp if deal includes explicit access clause

forecasts.question: Will Hormuz commercial vessel transit reach a 7-day rolling average of ≥24 transits per day (AIS-confirmed; AIS-dark vessels not included) by October 15, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: Lloyd's List AIS data (most recent, Sep 1-2) shows ~13 transits/24h — the authoritative real-time figure. Prior USNI figure of 16.3/day from Aug 28 likely includes naval vessels and covers a partial measurement period; Judge resolves methodological discrepancy in favour of Lloyd's as more operationally specific and recent. Sep 1 CENTCOM strikes inside Iran and IRGC retaliation to Jordan/UAE materially extend the conflict horizon for Hormuz reopening. Criterion text updated to add '7-day rolling average; AIS-dark vessels not included' for clarity. Baseline required: 24/day vs current 13 = 85% gap to close in 43 days under active military exchange. 0.13 reflects slim but non-zero chance of emergency ceasefire and rapid partial reopening.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if Lloyd's List or equivalent AIS-tracking authority publishes a 7-day rolling average of ≥24 commercial vessel transits per day through the Strait of Hormuz, excluding AIS-dark or naval vessels, sustained for any rolling 7-day window ending on or before Oct 15, 2026.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Lloyd's List AIS report OR UKMTO official advisory OR Kpler/Vortexa shipping data confirmed by ≥2 independent tracking services. IRGC or Iranian MFA claim alone = not qualifying.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A single-day spike to ≥24 without a sustained 7-day average = NO. A 7-day average between 20-23 = NO (threshold is hard at 24). Military transits excluded; AIS-dark vessels excluded from count.

indicators.name: Lloyd's List daily Hormuz transit count (7-day rolling)
indicators.expected_effect: Current ~13/day; needs to reach 24/day. Each +1/day sustained = +2pp toward YES

indicators.name: IRGC formal announcement of partial Hormuz reopening or safe-passage corridor
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp if TIER1-confirmed IRGC corridor announcement

indicators.name: US-Iran agreement or ceasefire with Hormuz clause
indicators.expected_effect: +20pp if deal signed with explicit Hormuz reopening timetable

forecasts.question: Will Israel form a new governing coalition with Gadi Eisenkot or another national-unity figure as Prime Minister by January 15, 2027?
forecasts.delta_reason: Coalition arithmetic re-examined: Eisenkot bloc requires 61-seat majority; current count 58-59 seats achievable without Haredi parties. Haredi draft brinkmanship ongoing; no confirmed defection from Netanyahu bloc. Knesset dissolution required before any new coalition possible — this remains unresolved. Judge recalibrates from 0.35 to 0.28 on the gap between 'coalition intent' and 'actual Knesset dissolution + new election + coalition formation' within the 135-day window. Ambiguity rule tightened: 'Minority government with Arab-list external abstention only = YES if Eisenkot sworn in as PM' — this closes the fake-coalition loophole.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if (a) the Knesset dissolves and a new election is called, AND (b) Eisenkot or another named national-unity figure is sworn in as Prime Minister of a coalition commanding ≥61 Knesset seats, by Jan 15 2027 23:59 UTC.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Israeli President's Office swearing-in ceremony confirmed by ≥2 TIER1 sources. A coalition agreement without swearing-in = not YES.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Minority government with Arab-list external abstention only = YES if Eisenkot is sworn in as PM. A unity deal announced but not ratified by Knesset vote by Jan 15 = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Netanyahu reshuffling his own coalition without dissolution = NO.

indicators.name: Knesset dissolution vote or no-confidence motion filed
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp if dissolution filed; gating prerequisite for YES

indicators.name: Haredi party defection from Netanyahu coalition (UTJ or Shas)
indicators.expected_effect: +10pp per major Haredi party defection

indicators.name: Eisenkot or opposition bloc public coalition memorandum
indicators.expected_effect: +8pp if formal written coalition framework published

forecasts.question: Will Iran's Ministry of Foreign Affairs issue a formal public statement specifying written preconditions for Hormuz reopening by September 2, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: Horizon reached Sep 2. No TIER1-confirmed MFA formal written preconditions statement found by either Analyst or DA in independent web verification. IRGC and Khamenei office statements on Hormuz conditions were repeated, but these do not qualify (criterion requires MFA formal statement specifically). Sep 1 CENTCOM strikes shifted MFA focus to retaliation posture rather than diplomatic signalling. RESOLVED-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if Iranian MFA (not IRGC, not Khamenei office) issues a formal public statement — press release, diplomatic note, or official spokesperson briefing — specifying written preconditions for Hormuz reopening, confirmed by ≥2 TIER1 sources, by Sep 2 23:59 UTC 2026.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP citing Iranian MFA official by name OR official MFA press release text. IRGC or Khamenei office statements do not qualify.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Oral statements by MFA spokesperson without written text = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Repetition of prior conditions without new specificity = NO.

indicators.name: Iranian MFA formal press briefing on Hormuz preconditions (TIER1 confirmed)
indicators.expected_effect: Was the primary YES indicator; NOT_OBSERVED at resolution confirms NO

forecasts.question: Will the US and Iran reach a mutual de facto or explicit strike pause — with no CENTCOM strikes inside Iran AND no IRGC strikes on US assets — for ≥72 consecutive hours by September 14, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: Sep 1: CENTCOM confirmed strikes on IRGC positions inside Iran (Qeshm, Jask bases). Same day: IRGC ballistic missile salvo toward Jordan and UAE confirmed by CENTCOM and UK NAVCENT. Both conditions for YES (mutual pause ≥72h) are directly contradicted by confirmed Sep 1 events. Both Analyst and DA independently reached RESOLVED-NO. p at resolution = 0.05 (schema floor; outcome is NO).
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if ≥72 consecutive hours pass with zero CENTCOM strikes inside Iranian territory AND zero IRGC or IRGC-proxy strikes on US military assets, confirmed by CENTCOM and at least one independent monitoring body, ending before Sep 14 23:59 UTC 2026.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official statement of no strikes + UKMTO advisory confirming no IRGC attack on US assets for the relevant 72h period. A unilateral US pause without Iranian reciprocity = NO.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A 72h pause on strikes but with active naval interdiction or tanker seizures ongoing = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A strike occurring within the 72h window that is later denied by both parties = AMBIGUOUS.

indicators.name: CENTCOM confirmed strike inside Iran (Sep 1, 2026)
indicators.expected_effect: CONTRADICTED = definitive NO at resolution for this window

indicators.name: IRGC ballistic missile strike toward Jordan/UAE (Sep 1, 2026)
indicators.expected_effect: CONTRADICTED = definitive NO at resolution for this window

forecasts.delta_reason: Resolved NO on Aug 31 by prior run: Sep 1 CENTCOM strikes inside Iran falsified the ceasefire-holds criterion before the Sep 30 horizon. Inherited from Aug 31 draft as RESOLVED-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if no confirmed mutual direct strikes between US and Iranian forces occur through Sep 30, 2026, and the MOU framework (or its successor) remains nominally active. One confirmed direct strike = NO.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM and US DoD statement + ≥2 TIER1 confirmation of any direct strike. Absence of confirmed strikes through Sep 30 = YES.

forecasts.question: Will the Netanyahu coalition collapse (defined as a no-confidence vote passing or PM resignation) before October 27, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: Resolved YES on Aug 31 by prior run: Netanyahu coalition formally lost Knesset majority by Jul 17 defection + Aug 5 no-confidence motion passing 63-57. Inherited from Aug 31 draft as RESOLVED-YES.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: RESOLVED-YES if a no-confidence motion passes the Knesset by majority vote OR Netanyahu formally submits resignation as PM before Oct 27, 2026 23:59 UTC.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + ≥2 TIER1 confirmation (Reuters/AP/AFP). Presidential acceptance of resignation required for YES if resignation route.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A coalition reshuffle that keeps Netanyahu as PM = NO. A no-confidence motion that fails or is withdrawn = NO. A confidence vote that passes = YES.
